extracted.name: Basic chocolat cake: normal and pimped
extracted.description: I learned this recipy in home economics a million years ago. Tomorrow a Child leaves the day centre a she wishes chocolat cake. This recipy makes 3 star shaped cakes. If you want only one regular cake Just half the recipy.
instruction_lines: Whip the whites with the salt
Cream the yolks with the sugar
Melt the butter and margarine. And add to egg sugar mixture
Melt the chocolat in a waterbad (au bain marie). Add to the mixture
Sift the flour and bakingpowder and add
Put in a baking tin and bake for 40 min in a 180° preheated oven.
